searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (last ~40 'opportunities' entries), data/applications.json (empty tracker), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions -- notably Notion BDR, Stripe New Grad PM Accelerator, Disney APM, Tuck Business Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps (recruiter screen in progress), Ford FCG, Red Ventures APM, TikTok APM, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, Adobe x3, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM -- all already applied to or closed, so excluded from any hunt regardless of egress state. Checked the graduation-date conflict this run's own instructions flagged as unresolved: life/PROFILE.md states December 2026 was SETTLED by Dom on 2026-08-04, and morning-briefing/profile.md already says December 2026 -- there is no live conflict, matching what the prior two runs also found; the 'Aug-Dec 2026 unsettled' framing in the scheduler's instructions is stale and should be corrected at the source. Before spending search/fetch budget, re-verified the WebFetch/egress path directly against www.anthropic.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, and boards-api.greenhouse.io: all three returned EGRESS_BLOCKED / CONNECT 403 'organization policy' from the proxy itself (confirmed via curl and the proxy's own /__agentproxy/status, which shows no job-board or company-careers domain on the allowlist -- only api.anthropic.com, package registries, and internal ranges are excepted). This is the seventh consecutive week this has happened (since ~2026-08-18). WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible-looking listings (e.g. an Anthropic Applied AI Architect req on Greenhouse), but hunt.md's honesty rules forbid including anything not confirmed by fetching the live page, which remains impossible in this environment. No candidate could be verified, so none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output for a seventh straight week -- this is an unresolved environment/org-level network-egress-policy gap (careers and job-board domains are not allowlisted for this session's proxy), not a shortage of findable roles, and needs a human to fix the egress allowlist; no amount of additional search or retry budget changes this outcome.
